descriptions: THE CORE COMMAND AND CONTROL, BATTLE MANAGEMENT AND COMMUNICATIONS (C2BMC) PROGRAM IS AN ELEMENT OF THE BALLISTIC MISSILE DEFENSE SYSTEM (BMDS).  THE C2BMC PROGRAM IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE END-TO-END MISSION COMMUNICATIONS NETWORK CONNECTIVITY BETWEEN BMDS ELEMENTS, COMBATANT COMMANDERS (COCOMS), SERVICES AND AGENCIES.  THE C2BMC SYSTEM, THROUGH THE BMDS COMMUNICATIONS NETWORK (BCN), LINKS TOGETHER THE EXTERNAL SENSORS AND WEAPONS OF INDEPENDENT ELEMENTS INTO A LAYERED MISSILE DEFENSE SYSTEM SUCH THAT THE WHOLE IS FAR MORE CAPABLE AND ROBUST THAN THE SUM OF ITS PARTS -- THUS INCREASING THE CAPABILITY OF THE BMDS WITH GREATER PERFORMANCE AND DEFENSIVE COVERAGE.
